description: Solid-body rotation via Path B (esd-5ou). Routes partial_h/partial_t = -partial_h/partial_lon through build_ode_problem -> ESS.discretize(sys, CubedSphereGrid) using the coord_jacobian chain rule for physical-to-computational coordinate transforms. Verifies return-to-IC after one full revolution (T = 2*pi for unit angular velocity, R = 1).

tolerance.comment: Ceiling for first integration sweep with Nc=8 on the unit sphere (R=1, angular velocity=1). The centered FD chain-rule scheme is non-dissipative; 50% of h0 allows for phase dispersion over one revolution. Tighten once cross-panel seam handling is validated end-to-end.
